facts: The frozen dense development baseline is 135.142469917 output tokens/s and the fixed ten-percent target is 148.656716909 output tokens/s.
The best comparable energy-Dk64 endpoint screen is 141.564496 output tokens/s, or 4.752041 percent above dense, and is not accepted.
Dk104 and Dk88 results on the frozen native decode path are runtime-invalid because padded state rows were copied out incorrectly; Dk128 and Dk64 passed the tested native decode golden gates.
The locked teacher corpus supports fit and held-out admission screens but does not prove NPU endpoint speed, task accuracy, or portability.

Nearby Q/K-only selector, sparse projection, phase-transition, tail-sketch, simple heterogeneous-width, reduction-specialization, and small-fusion variants were rejected only within their tested scopes.

Packed-addressing Stage 1 passed exact NPU eager, full-state, NPUGraph, guard, and pointer gates, while raw-normalization Stage 2 failed at the first valid arithmetic comparison and was reverted from the active tree.
Perfect removal of the measured separate L2 seam or complete packed front end cannot by itself close the remaining optimistic TPOT gap.

lessons.title: Reuse a frozen denominator until a material invariant changes
lessons.trigger: A DRRQR candidate is compared with the established dense control.
lessons.future_action: Reuse the frozen baseline unless model, runtime, common optimization, topology, device, or workload contract changes; if one changes, declare it and rebaseline both arms.
lessons.tested_scope: Qwen3.8-27B TP4 fixed-output development protocol on the qualified Ascend environment.
lessons.claim_ceiling: Comparable development screening, not final three-run acceptance.
lessons.verification: A future iteration names either the frozen baseline identity or the exact material change that forces a new one.

lessons.title: Prove the loaded execution path before optimizing it
lessons.trigger: A source file or kernel is used to explain current Ascend service behavior.
lessons.future_action: Bind worker dispatch, loaded source and dynamic-library identities before drawing a fusion or bottleneck conclusion; mark disproved conclusions superseded rather than silently retaining them.
lessons.tested_scope: The current Ascend GDN gating, L2-normalization, and native recurrent path.
lessons.evidence_level: worker-dispatch, source-hash, trace, and loaded-library evidence
lessons.claim_ceiling: Execution-path identity for the captured environment.
lessons.verification: Every operator iteration records the actual dispatch path and loaded binary identity.

lessons.title: Treat complete recurrent state as part of correctness
lessons.trigger: A DRRQR change mutates recurrent state or cache storage.
lessons.future_action: Compare output and complete mutable state over changing multi-step inputs, untouched slots, guards, storage identity, eager, and NPUGraph before any performance test.
lessons.tested_scope: Native recurrent Dk128/Dk64 controls and plugin-owned packed Stage 1 on physical NPU4.
lessons.claim_ceiling: Correctness for the declared shapes, steps, dtype, and environment only.
lessons.verification: The numerical gate fails closed on any output, full-state, guard, pointer, untouched-slot, or graph mismatch.

lessons.title: Do not infer an algorithm trend from invalid aligned storage
lessons.trigger: A logical rank crosses a native padding or alignment boundary.
lessons.future_action: Keep the alignment guard, repair CopyOut or storage semantics first, and rerun correctness before comparing pruning rates.
lessons.tested_scope: Frozen native decode state rows for Dk104 and Dk88 versus Dk128 and Dk64.
lessons.claim_ceiling: Runtime validity of the tested widths, not DRRQR accuracy or speed trend.
lessons.verification: Non-aligned candidates cannot enter endpoint or accuracy gates without a passing full-state test.

lessons.title: Optimize downstream recurrent output rather than a proxy
lessons.trigger: A new selector or transition improves retained energy, normalized-QK error, or state relative error.
lessons.future_action: Use a locked fit and held-out split and require post-recurrence or post-RMS output fidelity; stop nearby variants when proxy improvements do not transfer.
lessons.tested_scope: The frozen teacher corpus and the named Q/K-only, transition, sparse-subspace, and tail-compensation families.
lessons.claim_ceiling: Rejects only the tested configurations and nearby variants named in their iteration records.
lessons.verification: Held-out data is opened only after the candidate is locked and reports both aggregate and worst-head output behavior.

lessons.title: Require full-path foldability for structural reduction
lessons.trigger: A rank, channel, subspace, sketch, or heterogeneous-state proposal claims compute or memory savings.
lessons.future_action: Map checkpoint rows and columns, convolution and nonlinearities, state/cache allocation, normalization/gating, output projection, scheduler identity, and graph keys; charge every reconstruction, gather, conversion, or dense expansion to the cost model.
lessons.tested_scope: The rejected historical-tail sketch and the verified existing Dk64 Q/K projection plus convolution slicing path.
lessons.claim_ceiling: Implementation admission or rejection before code; no endpoint or quality claim.
lessons.verification: The candidate's reduced dimension remains reduced through every claimed hot-path saving, or the added work appears in its optimistic endpoint ceiling.

lessons.title: Use endpoint headroom to stop insufficient seams before implementation
lessons.trigger: A proposed operator change targets a measured DRRQR seam.
lessons.future_action: First prove the saving is not already active, then compare deliberately optimistic perfect-removal savings with the open endpoint gap; stop if it cannot close a material part.
lessons.tested_scope: Dk64 separate L2 normalization and the packed front end in the frozen diagnostic profile.
lessons.evidence_level: compiled-artifact, source, and optimistic cost model
lessons.claim_ceiling: Rejects the measured seam as the primary route; it is not an end-to-end benchmark.
lessons.verification: Every implementation iteration states the open TPOT/throughput gap and a quantified optimistic saving before code or NPU work.

lessons.title: Stage semantics and recover to the last safe boundary
lessons.outcome_class: failed implementation with accepted lower stage
lessons.trigger: A multi-stage native operator prototype passes layout or ABI checks and later fails arithmetic.
lessons.future_action: Keep the passed lower stage as the active recovery base, preserve the failed code and artifacts in history, and stop graph timing, endpoint, and accuracy for the failed stage.
lessons.evidence_level: target-NPU eager, full-state, graph, and first-step arithmetic comparison
lessons.claim_ceiling: Stage 1 ABI/storage admission only; Stage 2 is numerically failed.
lessons.verification: The active tree contains only the last safe stage and Git history retains both the failed implementation and its explicit revert.

lessons.title: Identify generated CANN operators by the complete vendor bundle
lessons.trigger: A generated custom operator is loaded for numerical or performance evidence.
lessons.future_action: Load and hash matching op_api, opmaster, and opsproto artifacts from one packaged vendor root before interpreting a result.
lessons.tested_scope: The raw-normalization Stage 2 generated operator bundle.
lessons.evidence_level: runtime load and operator execution identity
lessons.claim_ceiling: Runtime validity only; loading one library is not operator correctness.
lessons.verification: Evidence records all bundle paths and hashes and rejects mixed or incomplete roots.

lessons.title: Preserve remote operation identity and retry only after terminal proof
lessons.trigger: A remote build or command outlives the client wait, or its dedicated container is unavailable.
lessons.future_action: Poll the same operation, prove terminal state, inspect container and device state, and retry once only after correcting the concrete defect.
lessons.tested_scope: Remote native builds, container lifecycle, and Git push handling on chicaihong01.
lessons.claim_ceiling: Safe operational recovery, not algorithm evidence.
lessons.verification: A retry cites the prior operation identity, terminal state, and corrected cause instead of launching duplicate work.

do_not_ingest_as_durable_truth: Unverified future algorithm ideas or operator speed estimates.
A single microbenchmark as evidence of endpoint improvement.
Historical errors that have been superseded by loaded-path evidence.
Raw report contents, credentials, model weights, profiler payloads, or machine-live state.

commit_push.status_source: Use Git remote branch ancestry as the authoritative push state.
